name: STEM Gems Summer Camp
org: Boise State University College of Engineering
what_you_do: Go to a free overnight STEM camp at Boise State. Try workshops in engineering and science topics and see what college is like.
who_can_apply: Students currently in 9th, 10th or 11th grade (ages 14 to 17). Only 50 students are chosen.
pay_detail: Free to attend. It is not a paid job.
duration: Overnight camp (length and dates not stated on the program page)
deadline_text: Applications for summer 2026 are closed. They reopen in early 2027. A closing date is not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply when the application opens in early 2027. Chosen students get an email by mid May saying they have a spot. Questions: visitCOEN@boisestate.edu or 208-426-2688.
notes: The camp page does not list camp dates or the steps of the application. Watch the page in early 2027.
